The '''Mandalore prison outpost'''<ref name="Behind-the-Scenes Gallery">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/heroes-of-mandalore-behind-the-scenes-gallery|text="Heroes of Mandalore" Behind-the-Scenes Gallery}} {{C|Slides 11, 12, 13, and 14}}</ref> was an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[prison]] located on the [[planet]] [[Mandalore]].<ref name="Heroes of Mandalore" /> In approximately the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Chronology Note">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/heroes-of-mandalore-trivia-gallery|text="Heroes of Mandalore" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 5}} states that [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] was redesigned to advance the character's age by "18 [[Standard year|years]] or so" for her appearance in ''[[Heroes of Mandalore|Star Wars Rebels: Heroes of Mandalore]]''. As she was last seen was in "[[The Lawless]]," dated to [[19 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'', it can be assumed that the events of ''Heroes of Mandalore'' take place in approximately [[1 BBY]].</ref> [[Alrich Wren]], held hostage by the Galactic Empire in order to ensure his [[Clan Wren|family's]] cooperation, was moved there from [[Sundari]] to cut him off from allies he had in the [[Mandalorian]] [[capital]]. He did not remain there long, however, as he was placed on a [[K79-S80 Imperial Troop Transport|transport]] back to Sundari in order to be publicly [[Death|executed]], as Clan Wren was [[Mandalorian Civil War (Imperial Era)|engaged]] in open rebellion against [[Clan Saxon]], who had been placed in charge of Mandalore by [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]]. Alrich's daughter, [[Sabine Wren|Sabine]], led a [[Mission to Mandalore|raid]] on the prison shortly after he was relocated, which the Empire intended as a diversion so that the [[convoy]] carrying Alrich could reach Sundari safely.<ref name="Heroes of Mandalore" />
